```{r cars,fig.width=18,fig.height=20}
rm(list = ls())
setwd("~/Desktop/codes")

# ======================
# 0. Load required R packages
# ======================
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(tibble)
library(readxl)
library(ggtext)      # ★ 新增：用于渲染下标

# ======================
# 1. Element symbol mapping for MRG y-axis labels
# ======================
element_symbols <- c(
  "Aluminium"  = "Al", "Antimony" = "Sb", "Arsenic" = "As",
  "Cadmium"    = "Cd", "Chromium" = "Cr", "Cobalt"  = "Co",
  "Copper"     = "Cu", "Gold"     = "Au", "Iron"    = "Fe",
  "Lead"       = "Pb", "Magnesium" = "Mg", "Manganese" = "Mn",
  "Mercury"    = "Hg", "Molybdenum" = "Mo", "Nickel"  = "Ni",
  "Selenium"   = "Se", "Silver"    = "Ag", "Tellurium" = "Te",
  "Tungsten"   = "W",  "Vanadium"  = "V", "Zinc"    = "Zn"
)

label_with_symbol <- function(x) {
  ifelse(x %in% names(element_symbols),
         paste0(x, " (", element_symbols[x], ")"),
         x)
}

# ======================
# 2. Builder function
# ======================
build_figure <- function(xlsx_file, id_sheet, abund_sheet, plot_title) {
  
  # --- Read data ---
  co_loc <- read_excel(xlsx_file, sheet = id_sheet) %>%
    as.data.frame(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  abundance <- read_excel(xlsx_file, sheet = abund_sheet) %>%
    as.data.frame(stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
    column_to_rownames(var = names(.)[1])
  
  # --- Sample grouping table ---
  sample_group <- data.frame(
    sample = c("s1", "s2", "s3", "s4", "s5",
               "s6", "s7", "s8", "s9", "s10",
               "s11", "s12", "s13", "s14", "s15"),
    Treatment = c(rep("Control",  5),
                  rep("N50cess",  5),
                  rep("N50cont",  5)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  sample_group$Treatment <- factor(sample_group$Treatment,
                                   levels = c("Control", "N50cess", "N50cont"),
                                   ordered = TRUE)
  
  # --- Filter valid contig-ARG-MRG pairs ---
  pair_contig <- co_loc %>%
    select(contigs, ARG, MRG) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ARG), !is.na(MRG), !is.na(contigs)) %>%
    mutate(ARG = dplyr::recode(ARG,
                               "Disinfecting agents and antiseptics" = "DAAs")) %>%
    distinct(contigs, ARG, MRG, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  # --- Per-sample coverage score per ARG-MRG pair ---
  sample_score_list <- list()
  for (s in colnames(abundance)) {
    samp_abun <- abundance[, s, drop = FALSE] %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("contigs") %>%
      rename(abun = 2) %>%
      filter(!is.na(abun))
    
    samp_pair <- pair_contig %>%
      left_join(samp_abun, by = "contigs") %>%
      mutate(abun = ifelse(is.na(abun), 0, abun)) %>%
      group_by(ARG, MRG) %>%
      summarise(weighted_score = sum(abun), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(sample = s)
    
    sample_score_list[[s]] <- samp_pair
  }
  sample_scores <- bind_rows(sample_score_list)
  
  # --- Mean coverage per treatment ---
  treat_scores <- sample_scores %>%
    inner_join(sample_group, by = c("sample" = "sample")) %>%
    group_by(Treatment, ARG, MRG) %>%
    summarise(weighted_mean = mean(weighted_score), .groups = "drop")
  
  # --- Complete ARG-MRG grid ---
  full_grid <- expand.grid(ARG = unique(pair_contig$ARG),
                           MRG = unique(pair_contig$MRG),
                           stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  # --- Build per-treatment matrices ---
  treatment_matrix_list <- list()
  for (tr in levels(sample_group$Treatment)) {
    tr_scores <- treat_scores %>%
      filter(Treatment == tr) %>%
      right_join(full_grid, by = c("ARG", "MRG")) %>%
      mutate(weighted_mean = ifelse(is.na(weighted_mean) | weighted_mean <= 0.05,
                                    NA, weighted_mean)) %>%
      select(ARG, MRG, weighted_mean) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = ARG, values_from = weighted_mean) %>%
      column_to_rownames(var = "MRG") %>%
      as.matrix()
    treatment_matrix_list[[tr]] <- tr_scores
  }
  
  # --- Build 3 subplots (one per treatment) ---
  plot_list <- lapply(seq_along(treatment_matrix_list), function(i) {
    tr  <- names(treatment_matrix_list)[i]
    mat <- treatment_matrix_list[[tr]]
    mat_df <- as.data.frame(mat) %>%
      rownames_to_column("MRG") %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = -MRG, names_to = "ARG", values_to = "weighted_mean")
    
    # ★ 修改点 1：将标题转换为带 <sub> 的 HTML 格式
    tr_title <- dplyr::case_when(
      tr == "N50cont" ~ "N50<sub>cont</sub>",
      tr == "N50cess" ~ "N50<sub>cess</sub>",
      TRUE            ~ tr
    )
    
    p <- ggplot(mat_df, aes(x = ARG, y = MRG, fill = weighted_mean)) +
      geom_tile(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
      geom_text(
        aes(label = ifelse(!is.na(weighted_mean), round(weighted_mean, 1), "")),
        size = 4.5, color = "black"
      ) +
      scale_y_discrete(
        limits = sort(unique(mat_df$MRG), decreasing = TRUE),
        labels = label_with_symbol
      ) +
      scale_fill_gradientn(
        colors   = colorRampPalette(c("white", "yellow", "red"))(100),
        limits   = c(0, max(treat_scores$weighted_mean, na.rm = TRUE)),
        na.value = "white"
      ) +
      # ★ 使用 tr_title 替换原本的 tr
      labs(title = tr_title, x = NULL, y = NULL,
           fill = "Mean normalized coverage\nof ARG-MRG contigs (per Gb)") +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5,
                                   colour = "black", size = 13, face = "bold"),
        # ★ 修改点 2：将 plot.title 改为 element_markdown() 以渲染 <sub>
        plot.title  = element_markdown(hjust = 0.5, colour = "black",
                                       size = 13, face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 13, face = "bold"),
        panel.grid = element_blank()
      )
    
    if (i == 1) {
      p <- p + theme(axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black",
                                                size = 13, face = "bold"))
    } else {
      p <- p + theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
                     axis.ticks.y = element_blank())
    }
    return(p)
  })
  
  # --- Combine the 3 subplots into one figure ---
  combined <- wrap_plots(plot_list, nrow = 1, ncol = 3) +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect", widths = rep(1, 3)) +
    plot_annotation(
      title = plot_title,
      theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                              size = 16, face = "bold"))
    )
  return(combined)
}

# ======================
# 3. Build the two figures
# ======================
xlsx_file <- "~/Desktop/codes/data/Ex_Fig1_data.xlsx"

fig_a <- build_figure(
  xlsx_file,
  id_sheet    = "AMCC_ID",
  abund_sheet = "AMCC_abundance",
  plot_title  = "ARG-MRG co-localization on same contigs"
)

fig_b <- build_figure(
  xlsx_file,
  id_sheet    = "Plasmid_AMCC_ID",
  abund_sheet = "Plasmid_AMCC_abundance",
  plot_title  = "ARG-MRG co-localization on putative plasmid contigs"
)

# ======================
# 4. Stack vertically with a / b tags
# ======================
final_plot <- wrap_plots(
  wrap_elements(full = fig_a),
  wrap_elements(full = fig_b),
  ncol = 1
) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = list(c("a", "b"))) &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold"))

print(final_plot)

# ======================
# 5. Save
# ======================
ggsave(
  filename = "~/Desktop/codes/figures/Ex_Fig1ab.pdf",
  plot     = final_plot,
  width    = 18, height = 20, dpi = 300
)
```
